column1: # scripts/test_plan.tsv - what scripts/test.sh runs, in the order results are printed.
# One row per item, four tab-separated columns: kind, name, group, command. Blank lines and lines
# starting with # are skipped. A row that does not fit is an error that names this file and its line.
#   gate        name  -      command   a repository check (--gates, --gate NAME), run through `eval`
#                                      so $STAGE0_DIR and ${MAKE:-make} expand; the order of the rows is the
#                                      display order, so the slowest gate is last, because one slow gate holds
#                                      back every line after it (mutation-self-test builds four mutant
#                                      compilers, about a minute and a half)
#   extra-gate  name  -      command   a gate that `--gate NAME` runs and `--gates` does not
#   paths       -     group  roots     the per-file test roots of the group; every test belongs to exactly
#                                      one group, and a root may be a glob (tests/functional/*.zrl)
#   scenario    name  group  command   a multi-step script, run after its group's per-file tests; the
#                                      group `git` holds the ones that need git
